address: Galleria Mall, Al Wasl Road, Jumeirah 1, Dubai
bio: Vibrant, modern Japanese dishes – from sushi, uni and yakitori to sharing plates and Wagyu steak – are the order of the day at this funky, buzzing spot located in a smart mall. Keep an eye out for the daily chef’s specials and nice selection of mocktails! Prices are more than reasonable, and service is bright and keen; sit at the counter to watch the chefs at work....
